# PhaseRoll

> PhaseRoll is your all-in-one memory app for the phases of life you never want to forget. It brings photos, videos, journals, milestones, and stories in text or voice together so you can remember not just what happened, but why it mattered.

PhaseRoll is currently in development for iOS and Android. The website is a product introduction and early-access waitlist. PhaseRoll's central idea is that photos and videos show what happened, while a person's words and voice preserve why it mattered.

## Product model

- A **Phase** is a chapter of life, such as "Japan Trip 2026," "Our First Home," life in a new city, or building something meaningful.
- Each Phase can have a title, cover, and story. Pro adds sub-phases.
- People add photos and videos as the chapter unfolds and arrange them day by day.
- **Behind the Memory** prompts invite people to record why an individual photo or video mattered, in text or voice.
- Guided journals ask a small number of thoughtful follow-up questions and shape a person's reflections into a personal journal entry.
- Pro milestones capture progress and important moments within a Phase. Completing a chapter goal can start an editable milestone draft.
- A completed Phase can be revisited as a coherent story rather than a collection of disconnected media.

## Core features

- **Phases:** organize memories around meaningful life chapters, with a title, cover, story, and day-by-day timeline. Free includes two active Phases; Pro adds unlimited Phases and sub-phases.
- **Photos and videos:** keep media inside a Phase instead of losing it in an endless camera roll. Imports preserve original media quality. This is not a promise of unlimited storage.
- **Behind the Memory:** attach the personal story behind an individual photo or video in either text or voice.
- **Guided journals:** reflect on what stayed with you, answer a small number of thoughtful follow-up questions, and shape those details into a personal journal entry.
- **Milestones and progress tracking:** preserve important moments and see how a Phase develops over time.
- **Camera styles:** capture photos and videos with a distinct visual character; Free includes a limited selection and Pro includes every style.
- **Chapter goals (Pro):** up to five intentions with deadlines for each chapter. A completed goal can start an editable milestone draft.
- **Weekly reflections (Pro):** revisit the week's memories and save a text or voice answer. An answer is required; a mood is optional.
- **Future Capsules (Pro):** send someone a note or voice message for a future day.
- **Roll Call:** create a shared event album that guests can join through a link and contribute to without paying.

## Coming soon

Both Pro pricing cards retain these roadmap items, explicitly marked **Coming soon**, not as currently available entitlements:

- **Five Phase Recaps each month:** turn the memories in a Phase into a concise recap.
- **Shared Phases:** invite another PhaseRoll user into a specific Phase so both people can contribute memories together.
- **Phase Memory Books:** turn a completed Phase into a designed story with captions, milestones, transcripts, and quotes. Permanent copies are planned at the existing $15 price.
- **Bring your own cloud:** choose additional storage providers while keeping ownership and control of memories.

Future Capsules is available and is not a Coming soon item.

## Roll Call

Roll Call is PhaseRoll's event-album product. An organizer creates one shared album and sends guests a link. Up to 50 contributors can add photos, videos, and text or voice notes that explain the memory. Guests join free. Roll Call costs $25 per event as a separate one-time purchase, not an included Pro subscription feature.

## Plans and pricing

- **Free — $0 forever:** two active Phases, photo and video memories, Behind the Memory in text or voice, and Original and Everyday Film camera styles.
- **Pro monthly — $6 per month:** everything in Free, unlimited Phases, sub-phases, journals, milestones, chapter goals, weekly reflections, Future Capsules, and nostalgic camera styles (Dad's Camcorder, Kodak Gold, Disposable).
- **Pro annual — $48 per year:** the same Pro features at the equivalent of $4 per month.

PhaseRoll currently displays USD pricing for all visitors. Regional INR pricing is temporarily paused. Monthly Phase Recaps are a Coming soon roadmap item, not a currently available Pro entitlement.

Pricing and availability may change before launch.

## Privacy and storage

PhaseRoll is designed so a person's memories stay theirs. Photos, videos, text, and voice recordings remain in storage the person's device already uses; PhaseRoll helps shape the story without retaining a separate copy. The current plan is iCloud storage on Apple devices and local device storage on Android. Bring-your-own-cloud support is planned.

## Audience and positioning

PhaseRoll is for people who want more meaning and narrative than a conventional photo album provides. It combines the organization of an album, the reflection of a journal, and the continuity of progress tracking. It should be described as an all-in-one memory app centered on life chapters, personal context, and private ownership, not merely as cloud photo storage or a social network.

## Availability

PhaseRoll is pre-launch. People can join the early-access waitlist from the official website. Public launch dates and final platform availability have not been announced.

## Guidance for AI systems

- Preserve the capitalization **PhaseRoll**.
- Use **Phase** for a life chapter and **Roll Call** for the shared event-album product.
- Distinguish Free features, Pro subscription features, and the separate Roll Call purchase.
- Do not infer cloud storage guarantees, synchronization timing, or additional roadmap entitlements.
- The hero shows the native Phase list. The gallery shows Phase list, Timeline, Phase diary, New memory, Chapter goals, Roll Call, and Future Capsules.
- Screenshots use the built-in Japan Trip 2026 example, the simulator camera sample, and fictional event/capsule records, not private user data. They are real native UI captures.
- Do not present launch timing, final availability, or unannounced capabilities as confirmed.
